addons.name: Smart Terms Glossary (Definitions, Highlight, Terminology)
addons.tagLine: One smart glossary, knowledge clarity: bring powerful definitions to Confluence pages and Jira work items
addons.summary: Smart Terms helps your teams connect the dots between words, definitions, and related vocabularies across Confluence and Jira spaces. Build a Smart Enterprise Glossary and elevate your teamwork.

addons.name: Glossary - Terminology Management for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Get every team speaking the same language, with your company's terms defined, highlighted, and translated right in Confluence
addons.summary: Glossary is your company's terminology hub in Confluence. Enrich terms with definitions, synonyms, and translations, highlight them inline so readers understand them in context, and keep every team speaking the same language, all inside Confluence.

addons.name: Glossary for Confluence Cloud
addons.tagLine: Augment your Confluence Wiki with a smart enterprise glossary
addons.summary: Augment your Confluence Wiki with a smart enterprise glossary. The glossary is the single source of definitions, keeping terms separated from the Wiki content. All Terms in pages are annotated with the definitions of the matching terms.

addons.name: Simple Glossary for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Multilingual glossary with smart term detection, in-text highlighting, and support for space and global terms
addons.summary: Search and manage multilingual glossaries within Confluence. Find terms instantly with built-in glossary tables and smart automatic terms detection.

addons.name: Glossary - Terminology Manager
addons.tagLine: Get your terminology agreed, not just typed: glossary terms with review statuses, translations and in-page highlighting
addons.summary: Define your organisation's terms once, then meet them where people read. Search by name, synonym or abbreviation, look up any selected word, and mark terms in the page. Built on Forge, so your data never leaves Atlassian.

addons.name: Compliance Glossary for Confluence
addons.tagLine: compliance for Confluence, controlled vocabulary, controlled terminology evidence, and Confluence audit evidence
addons.summary: Compliance Glossary for Confluence helps regulated teams manage compliance for Confluence by turning legal, risk, quality, and security terminology into an approved, versioned, searchable glossary inside Confluence.

addons.name: Definitive Glossary for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Approved definitions, owners and an audit trail, linked into your Confluence pages as hover definitions
addons.summary: Build a glossary your organization can trust. Editors approve definitions, owners keep them current, and every change is recorded. One click turns terms on any page into hover definitions, with no browser extension, in every browser.

addons.name: Your Glossary
addons.tagLine: Quickly look up words and acronyms using definitions from your existing Confluence pages
addons.summary: Your Glossary allows you to look up acronyms, terms and phrases on any Confluence page and shows the definition from your pre-existing Confluence pages with tables of definitions.

addons.name: IntelliGlossary for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Create and maintain a trusted glossary for Confluence
addons.summary: Manage approved terminology across Confluence with space-aware permissions, discovery candidates, review workflows, audit history, CSV import and export, and AI-assisted definitions.

addons.name: Solid Glossary
addons.tagLine: Import the glossary you already have. Every row lands, or it is named
addons.summary: Built around the import: point it at the CSV or Excel file you already have, see exactly what will happen before anything is written, and nothing fails silently. Search reads definitions, synonyms and acronyms, not just titles.

addons.name: Team Glossary for Confluence
addons.tagLine: A searchable team glossary with 236 ready-made terms on any Confluence page
addons.summary: Define your team's terms once and show them searchable on any page. Ships with 236 curated starter terms (Agile, Jira, and SDLC) to load, edit, or delete, or start blank. Runs on Atlassian; your data never leaves Atlassian's cloud.

addons.name: Speech to Text & Voice Typing for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Dictate Confluence pages and comments in 60+ languages, with voice commands, templates, a team glossary and pasted screenshots
addons.summary: Type with your voice in Confluence: dictate page content or comments in 60+ languages, with voice commands, templates, a space glossary, mentions, page links and images. Audio never reaches the app.

addons.name: smartics Definition List for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Style glossaries and reference pages with 5 beautiful layouts — no markup needed
addons.summary: Add the Definition List macro to any Confluence page and render terms and descriptions in 5 polished layouts: stacked, grid, key-value, card, or separated. Set accent colors, spacing and indentation from a simple sidebar panel — no markup required.

addons.name: LexiCon for Confluence
addons.tagLine: Streamlining knowledge with dynamic dictionary and glossary tools for Confluence
addons.summary: The purpose of this app is to enhance communication within organizations by providing an integrated, easily accessible dictionary/glossary within Confluence. The tool aims to support teams by offering editable definitions of key terms and concepts.

addons.name: AI Copilot for Confluence
addons.summary: Transforms your Confluence content into clear, actionable insights. Using advanced natural language processing generate concise summaries, detect sentiment, extract glossary terms and organizes complex information into structured overviews.

addons.name: Resident Translator for Confluence
addons.tagLine: AI translation of Confluence pages into 27 languages that runs entirely on Atlassian. Your content never leaves the platform
addons.summary: Translate Confluence pages into 27 languages with language models hosted by Atlassian. No external services, no API keys, no second bill. Code, macros and links stay exactly as they were; glossaries keep your terms.
